Receiver radial motion and source radial motion are conceptually distinct; no numerical Doppler exercise or arbitrary decimal logarithm is assigned.
records.pedagogicalReview: Separatesmediumspeed, fixed-interfacefrequency, echodoublepath andlogarithmicratio.10dB relation is exactly manual. records.physicalAssumptions: Echo formula assumes stationary uniform propagation and fixed reflector/coincident stationary source/receiver; no unaccounted wind or moving-boundary correction. Decibel intensity ratio is positive/dimensionless with sameunits, reference1e-12W/m² inair. Intensitylevel isnot perceived loudness or pressurelevel. Doppler diagram explicitlysubsonic, classical medium andradial directions; transverse motion needs the stated usual radial approximation, not relativistic transverseDoppler.

records.manualArithmetic: Planck working h is explicitly approximate6.626e-34J*s, distinct from exact SI6.62607015e-34J*s. Per-photon hf and total photonrate*hf distinguish photon energy from total beam power; monochromaticity is required to infer a single photoncount from total energy. Constant fractional removal integrates dI/dx=-muI to I0exp(-mu*x). Exact half-thickness ln2/mu is symbolic; at two/three half layers the transmitted fractions are1/4 and1/8. Actual0.25 means25percent transmitted and75percent absorbed only under the text no-other-loss qualifier. Forcm^-1 the thickness must usecm or be converted:2cm^-1*3cm=6 versus2cm^-1*3m=600. No unprovided logarithm or exponential decimal evaluation is demanded.
records.pedagogicalReview: Separatesper-photon andtotalenergy; ionization thresholddepends onmaterial/process. Half-layerdiagram teachesfractional,notconstantabsolute,removal. Direct-beam attenuation andpureabsorption arequalified; dimensionsofmu mustmatchthickness.
records.physicalAssumptions: Single-photon threshold statements, not exclusionofall nonlinear multiphoton processes. Monochromaticbeam andassigned material/process ionizationthreshold. Homogeneous constantmu,nonnegative thickness andmu>0 for finitehalfthickness; detectorselectsdirectbeam, scatteringout maycontributeattenuation. Absorptionfraction equalsmissingtransmission only absentotherlosses. happroximation explicit,lambda0 isvacuum wavelength.

records.figureReview: FullXML/render:threeboxes at0,T_half,2T_half contain32,16,8 dots andlabelN0,N0/2,N0/4. Caption/titleexplicitlyexpectedcounts; dotsarenotclaimed exactrealizations ofsmallstochastic samples.
records.manualArithmetic: Independent survival law solves dN/dt=-lambda_d*N, with activity-lambda derivative positive. At ln2/lambda_d the expected population and activity halve; alternate2^(-t/T_half) is algebraically equivalent. Actual figure has32/16/8 dots explicitly labelled expected counts, not guaranteed realizations. Finite decay probability is1-exp(-lambda_d*dt), with lambda_d the infinitesimal rate; replacing it by lambda_d*dt for longintervals is excluded. Reviewer binomial variance at32 nuclei andhalf survival is8. Toy80Bq,quarter efficiency and3/s background gives23/s measured; subtracting3 and dividingbyonequarter recovers80Bq. Alpha daughter losesA4,Z2; beta-minus neutron toproton+electron+antineutrino conserves charge andleptonnumber, beta-plus reverses withpositron+neutrino; gamma changesexcitationenergy without A/Z change. Numeric nuclear examples are reviewer checks, not source assignments.
records.pedagogicalReview: Expectedpopulationsfigureavoidsclaimingpredictableindividualdecay. Distinguisheslambda_dfromwavelength, activityfromcounts, parentexponentialfromnewproduction, and beta/gamma/alpha nuclearaccounting. Manualhalving doesnotrequiredecimalexponential evaluation.
records.physicalAssumptions: Large identical independent nuclei withconstant decayhazard, isolated singleparent specieswithoutnewproduction forsimpleexponential/activityhalving; population equations giveexpectations. Unpredictable individualdecay isnot deterministictimehalving. Decaychannels mustbeenergeticallyallowed inthenucleus; beta-plus description doesnotclaimfree protondecay. Measured counts needbackground/efficiency andemissionbranchingconditions, notautomaticallyBq; activityisnotdose.
